Iced Lana del Fog (Discourse Coffee)
Iced version of the Lana del Fog: Earl Grey, oat milk, vanilla, non-alcoholic amaretto, and orange bitters,
finished with a flamed orange peel.

Ingredients
2 Earl Grey tea bags (Rishi Earl Grey)
6 fl oz water
1/2 fl oz vanilla syrup
1/2 fl oz non-alcoholic amaretto (Lyre's Amaretti)
3 orange bitters
4 fl oz cold oat milk
1 orange peel, at least 2 inches long
1 cup of ice

Steps
1. Place 2 Earl Grey tea bags (Rishi Earl Grey) in a heatproof container and fill with 6 fl oz water at 205F.
Steep for 5 minutes to make a concentrate. While steeping, stir in 1/2 fl oz vanilla syrup, 1/2 fl oz non-
alcoholic amaretto (Lyre's Amaretti), and 3 orange bitters drops of 3 orange bitters. (5m)
2. Remove and discard the tea bags. Let the concentrate cool for a few minutes so it won't melt the ice too
fast.
3. Fill a 12 oz glass with 1 cup of ice.
4. Pour the cooled tea concentrate over the ice, then top with 4 fl oz cold oat milk.
5. Cut the 1 orange peel, at least 2 inches long. Hold a lighter or torch over the glass and warm the peel
with the flame, then express the oil (bright side facing the drink) through the flame onto the surface  of the drink.

Notes
Doubling the tea bags and cutting the water gives you a concentrated brew so it doesn't taste watery once
poured over ice. Let the concentrate cool a few minutes before pouring over ice, or the ice will melt too fast
and dilute it. Oat milk won't steam for iced, so just shake or froth it cold if you want some foam on top.

The Emerald Isle Sour
A nutty, citrusy twist on a classic whiskey sour
Ingredients
2 oz Irish whiskey (Jameson or Tullamore D.E.W.)
1 oz pistachio Irish cream (like Baileys Pistachio or homemade)
¾ oz fresh lemon juice
½ oz simple syrup
1 egg white (optional, for froth)
Crushed pistachios + green sugar for rim
Instructions
Rim your glass with honey, then dip in crushed pistachios and green sugar.
Combine all ingredients in a shaker without ice and dry shake for 15 seconds (this builds the foam).
Add ice and shake vigorously for another 15 seconds.
Double strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with a few drops of bitters on the foam and a shamrock pick.

Bellini

Ingredients

2 oz chilled white peach puree
4 oz well-chilled Prosecco
1 tsp fresh lemon juice
2 fresh raspberries
1 peach slice
Directions

To make the puree, peel and blend fresh, ripe white peaches until uniformly smooth. Add a couple of raspberries for a pinker color. Strain through mesh sieve for silky texture. Pour two ounces of the cold purée into a chilled champagne flute and slowly top with four ounces of cold sparkling wine. Stir gently to preserve carbonation. Garnish with a peach slice.
